messages:
Priya (Prod): Quick sync — multiple accounts saying competitor shipped a "cost/latency mode" and asking what our short/medium plan is. I want a concise decision: ship a parity shim, or push for a richer differentiator and delay.
Lucas (PM): Do we have telemetry showing it's a blocker for conversion or retention? If it's mostly procurement asks (pricing predictability) we can do config/contract work.
Evan (Sales): Signal is real. Two deals stalled in legal because infra cost feared to spike. They asked for: 1) predictable per-request pricing tiers, 2) an admin toggle to prefer lower-cost model variants. They didn't demand UX parity.
Tara (Eng): Engineering view: simple admin toggle is ~4 dev-days if we reuse routing policy plumbing. Guaranteeing quality tiers (SLA'd) is much bigger — needs eval harness, model variants in catalog, and rollout tooling.
Robin (Design): If we go parity-shim, the UX can be minimal (checkbox + short explanation). If we take longer route, we should design a quality tier selector with examples showing tradeoffs.
Maya (CS): From post-sales: customers will need clear guidance on what flows are "safe" for cheaper/quantized models. A small checklist in onboarding could reduce support overhead.
Lucas (PM): Proposal: two-track response. Track A (immediate): offer contractual pricing band + Managed Config (admin toggle) + docs checklist. Track B (Q): build console-grade Quality Modes with per-route presets, telemetry, and eval gating. We should decide which is resourced this quarter.
Priya (Prod): I like two-track. Acceptance criteria for Track A: deployable config, docs with checklist, legal-approved billing language, and pilot with at least 2 customers. No console changes. Target: 3 weeks.
Tara (Eng): Callouts: need a vetted quantized model in catalog. If we use existing quantized-1 for pilot, we must run a 24h A/B on representative prompts. Estimate: 2 engineers x 1 week for validation + 3 days for routing config.
Evan (Sales): Pilot customers lined up: BetaCo and RetailInc. Both okay to run pilot if we promise rollback and daily check-ins.
Maya (CS): Support playbook: how to diagnose quality regressions, escalate to engineering, and how to flip the toggle. Also include a sample prompt set for live checks.
Robin (Design): I'll draft the minimal admin panel copy: label: "Cost-optimized responses (may reduce fidelity)" with a "recommended for: background tasks, summarization" blurb. Tooltip links to checklist.
Lucas (PM): Metrics to gate expansion: 1) customer-reported regressions <= 3% in pilot sample, 2) p99 latency reduction >= 20%, 3) cost-per-token delta >= 15% savings, and 4) no billing disputes in pilot.
Priya (Prod): Risk register: possible perception of ship-of-mistakes if toggle leaks to public docs before we have telemetry. Also regulatory risk for sensitive data — default must be OFF for orgs with compliance flags.
ops-bot: Ticket #PROD-4927 created: "Pilot: cost-optimized routing for BetaCo & RetailInc" assigned to @Tara, due 1777777700.
Tara (Eng): I'll scope and post a short tech plan in the ticket by EOD. If we keep scope narrow (Managed Config + model variant validation) we can commit to 3 weeks.
Priya (Prod): Great. Lucas, assemble the pilot acceptance checklist and I'll coordinate legal/comms. We'll reconvene Friday for a go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
